high_level_description: The image depicts the exterior of an espresso bar named "ESPRESSO BAR." The establishment is housed in a building with white walls and a dark wooden door frame. Above the entrance, there is a blue awning with the name "ESPRESSO BAR" written in white capital letters. The awning also features a logo consisting of a geometric design with the letters "H" and "P" inside it. Inside the bar, through the glass window, we can see the interior setup. There are three brown leather bar stools with black metal legs positioned at the counter. A person wearing a white off-the-shoulder top is seated
